ruleDefinitions.name: Uninstall Sysinternals Sysmon
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the removal of Sysmon, which could be a potential attempt at defense evasion

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\Sysmon64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Sysmon\\\.exe$")) OR process_description = "System\ activity\ monitor") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-u.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/u.*")))
